title: Earn with 0 followers
subtitle: 5 income streams with no follower minimum, the pay and the catch
sections: 1. UGC (user-generated content)
Brands pay for videos they run as their own ads.
Pay: beginners usually charge $50-$400 per video (Insense, Sep 2026).
First step: film 3 sample videos with your phone.
Catch: no brand says yes before it sees samples.
2. Amazon Associates
Earn a commission when people buy through your links.
Pay: most categories about 3-4.5%. Example: $40 item at 4.5% = about $1.80.
Catch: 3 qualifying sales in your first 180 days or the account closes.
3. Etsy templates
Sell digital templates; buyers find you through Etsy search.
Pay: on a $10 sale you keep about $8.60 (US) after $0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction and ~3% + $0.25 payment fees.
Catch: popular niches are crowded.
4. ElevenLabs Voice Library
Share a Professional Voice Clone (Creator plan or above).
Paid only when paying users use it, through Stripe, usually from a $10 balance.
Catch: income depends on demand for your voice.
5. Fiverr gigs
List a service (UGC, editing, voiceover).
Fiverr keeps 20% of each order, including tips; 14-day clearance for new sellers.
Catch: new gigs need reviews before orders come steadily.
steps: Pick ONE stream that fits what you enjoy.
Do its first step this week.
Try the free AI Income Finder on subcreatorpaid.com to see which fits you.
